basic_details.job_title: NIT Mizoram Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 3 Associate Professor, Assistant Professor Posts
basic_details.post_name: Associate Professor, Assistant Professor Grade – II (On Contract)
basic_details.short_information: National Institute of Technology Mizoram (NIT Mizoram), Aizawl, has invited applications for 3 posts in 2 roles under Advt No. NITMZ/R-1/F/16/2026/2218. The posts include Associate Professor, Assistant Professor Grade – II (On Contract). Applications go by email to [email protected] and must be sent by 30 November 2026.

qualification.education_qualification: Ph.D. in relevant discipline with requisite academic record and experience

how_to_apply: Fill the prescribed application form completely.
Attach self-attested copies of all certificates, mark sheets, testimonials, and payment receipt.
Send the completed application form along with supporting documents via email to [email protected] on or before 30.11.2026 (5:00 PM).
important_instructions: The last date of submission of application form is 30.11.2026 (till 5:00 PM).

content_sections.heading: Key Points
content_sections.text: Last date: 30 November 2026 Vacancies: 3, in 2 roles How to apply: By email to [email protected] Fee: General and OBC: Rs. 1,000; SC/ST: Rs. 500; Women, PWD candidates and Internal Faculty members: Exempted Pay: Pay Level 13A2 and Level 10 (7th CPC) Place: Mizoram

content_sections.heading: NIT Mizoram Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. NITMZ/R-1/F/16/2026/2218 gives the full conditions for each post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download NIT Mizoram notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply for NIT Mizoram Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Other conditions: Separate application forms must be submitted for candidates applying for more than one Department or Post. Candidates serving in Government, Semi-Government, PSUs, Universities, or Educational Institutions must send applications through proper channel or furnish NOC, Integrity Certificate, and Vigilance Clearance Certificate at the time of interview.

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for NIT Mizoram Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates who have obtained their most recent degree (Ph.D.) from NIT Mizoram, normally, will not be considered unless there is a 3-year gap between leaving the Institute and the last date of submission of the online application.

content_sections.heading: Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: Qualification required: Ph.D. with requisite experience. Pay: Pay Level 13A2. Qualification required: Ph.D. Pay: Pay Level 10.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Period of Probation is one year, extendable by the Board of Governors.

content_sections.heading: How Will NIT Mizoram Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Shortlisting based on qualifications, experience and credit points Presentation and Interview Presentation and Interview by Selection Committee

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Proof of payment of application fee Matriculation or 10th standard certificate for age proof Higher Secondary / Class XII mark sheet and certificate UG and PG degree certificates and semester-wise mark sheets Ph.D. degree certificate or notification Caste/Tribe/Community certificate in prescribed proforma Disability/Medical certificate if applicable Photo identity card

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIT Mizoram Recruitment 2026 by Email
content_sections.text: Fill the prescribed application form completely. Attach self-attested copies of all certificates, mark sheets, testimonials, and payment receipt. Send the completed application form along with supporting documents via email to [email protected] on or before 30.11.2026 (5:00 PM).

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: The last date of submission of application form is 30.11.2026 (till 5:00 PM).

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NIT Mizoram Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in NIT Mizoram Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 1 Associate Professor, 2 Assistant Professor Grade – II (On Contract).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for NIT Mizoram Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 30 November 2026. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: General and OBC: Rs. 1,000. SC/ST: Rs. 500. Women, PWD candidates and Internal Faculty members: Exempted.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Pay Level 13A2 for Associate Professor, Pay Level 10 for Assistant Professor Grade – II (On Contract).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Ph.D. in relevant discipline with requisite academic record and experience. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Separate application forms must be submitted for candidates applying for more than one Department or Post. Candidates serving in Government, Semi-Government, PSUs, Universities, or Educational Institutions must send applications through proper channel or furnish NOC, Integrity Certificate, and Vigilance Clearance Certificate at the time of interview.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates who have obtained their most recent degree (Ph.D.) from NIT Mizoram, normally, will not be considered unless there is a 3-year gap between leaving the Institute and the last date of submission of the online application.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting based on qualifications, experience and credit points. Presentation and Interview. Presentation and Interview by Selection Committee.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Period of Probation is one year, extendable by the Board of Governors.
